en: A vintage, monochrome panoramic view over a city surrounded by hills and dense trees in the foreground. The skyline shows scattered church towers and historic buildings. At the top center-left is the printed title "Graz." and at the top right the word "Panorama." On the left margin, vertically, appears the publisher information. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
